messages: Every carnation in this field is for you, and there's always one more about to bloom.
Red carnations mean deep love and admiration — exactly what this whole field is trying to say.
Some things are meant to keep growing, no matter how long it takes. This is one of them.
You are the reason this garden never stops blooming.
A field this full still isn't enough to hold how much you mean to me.
Plant a little patience, water it with kindness, and watch what grows.
Thinking of you today, and pretty much every day the flowers keep coming.
Here's a small note tucked between the petals, just for you.
No matter how many bloom, you'll always be my favorite one in the field.
Some gardens are grown with water and sun. This one is grown with love.
